extension.disclaimer: This script only resolves video content from legitimate file lockers without prejudice. If this script is being used by 3rd parties to resolve content that you feel infringes upon your Intellectual Property then please take your complaints to the actual website or developer linking to such content and not here. This script in no way searches for any content whatsoever.

Εάν το ανωτέρο σενάριο χρησιμοποιηθεί από τρίτους ώστε να επιλύσει περιεχόμενο το οποίο σας προκαλεί αντίδραση ότι παραβιάζει την πνευματική σας ιδιοκτησία παρακαλώ μεταφέρετε τα παραπονά σας στον ιστότοπο τον οποίο βρίσκεται το εν λόγω περιεχόμενο η τον δημιουργό ο οποίος πραγματοποιεί την σύνδεση και όχι εδω. extension.description: XSCleaner keeps your Kodi installation clean and fast. Features include cache cleanup, thumbnail management, database optimization, backup/restore, advanced settings editor, and more.
XSCleaner hält Ihre Kodi-Installation sauber und schnell. Funktionen umfassen Cache-Bereinigung, Thumbnail-Verwaltung, Datenbank-Optimierung, Backup/Restore, Advanced Settings Editor und mehr.
extension.disclaimer: Use at your own risk. Always backup before making changes.
Verwendung auf eigene Gefahr. Erstellen Sie vor Änderungen immer ein Backup.
extension.news: v1.3.8 - Fix: Missed scheduled auto-backups are offered at the next Kodi start even when no backup has ever run — the scheduled time is now persisted and moved forward after each handled slot - Fix: dav/davs (WebDAV) backup folders can now be selected and created — Kodi only creates whole folder trees for local/SMB/NFS paths, WebDAV folders are now created step by step and bogus remote file sizes are ignored v1.3.7 - New: Scheduled automatic full backups with configurable interval and hour, run silently by the service - New: Missed scheduled backups are offered at the next Kodi start - Fix: Backup folder browser showed files instead of subfolders (wrong element of xbmcvfs.listdir read) - New: "Choose this folder" as first highlighted browser entry, "Edit Backup Path" jump, pre-filled manual path input - New: Progress dialog while navigating SMB/NFS/FTP folders and during the network write check - Change: Hidden system folders starting with "@" are hidden in the folder browser v1.3.6 - New: Addon Storage — browse addons and addon data by disk usage (sizes cached) - Change: Dashboard sizes always measured fresh; main menu no longer cached by Kodi v1.3.5 - Change: Backups are single ZIP archives — no more per-file transfers that hang on slow shares - New: Restore downloads, verifies and swaps data in atomically; failures leave data untouched - Fix: Network operations run with timeouts instead of hanging on dropped shares - Change: ZIP backup format (older folder backups no longer restorable) - Fix: Failed uploads are removed;
